```{r data}
library(dplyr)
library(copula)
library(MASS)

# Read data

setwd("file_path")
a<-read.csv("daily_data.csv")

b1<-a[,c(3,7,9)]
b2<-a[,c(4,6,9)]
b3<-a[,c(3,8,9)]
b4<-a[,c(4,8,9)]
```

```{r b1}
get_bic <- function(fit, u) {
  -2 * as.numeric(logLik(fit)) + length(coef(fit)) * log(nrow(u))
}

# Convert data to pseudo-observations (copula scale)
u <- pobs(b1)

# Define copulas
clayton_base <- claytonCopula(dim = 3)
surv_clayton_copula <- rotCopula(clayton_base, flip = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE))  # 180° rotation = survival Clayton

gumbel_copula <- gumbelCopula(dim = 3)
frank_copula  <- frankCopula(dim = 3)

# Fit the copulas to data
fitsc <- fitCopula(surv_clayton_copula, u, method = "mpl")
fitg  <- fitCopula(gumbel_copula, u, method = "mpl")
fitf  <- fitCopula(frank_copula, u, method = "mpl")

# Extract estimated theta
theta_hatsc <- coef(fitsc)
theta_hatg  <- coef(fitg)
theta_hatf  <- coef(fitf)


# Standard errors
sd_hatsc <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fitsc)))
sd_hatg  <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fitg)))
sd_hatf  <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fitf)))

bic_sc <- get_bic(fitsc, u)
bic_g  <- get_bic(fitg, u)
bic_f  <- get_bic(fitf, u)

cat("BIC for survival Clayton:", bic_sc, "\n")
cat("BIC for Gumbel:", bic_g, "\n")
cat("BIC for Frank:", bic_f, "\n")

# Print results
print(fitsc)
print(fitg)
print(fitf)

# Print
cat("Estimated Theta for survival Clayton:", theta_hatsc, "\n")
cat("SD / SE for survival Clayton:", sd_hatsc, "\n\n")

cat("Estimated Theta for Gumbel:", theta_hatg, "\n")
cat("SD / SE for Gumbel:", sd_hatg, "\n\n")

cat("Estimated Theta for Frank:", theta_hatf, "\n")
cat("SD / SE for Frank:", sd_hatf, "\n")
```

```{r normal_t_b1}
# Convert data to pseudo-observations (copula scale)
u <- pobs(b1)

# ---------------------------
# Gaussian copula
# ---------------------------
gaussian_copula <- normalCopula(dim = 3, dispstr = "un")
fit_gaussian <- fitCopula(gaussian_copula, u, method = "mpl")

# Extract estimated parameters
coef_gaussian <- coef(fit_gaussian)

# Standard errors
se_gaussian <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fit_gaussian)))

# Print results
print(fit_gaussian)

cat("Estimated parameters for Gaussian copula:\n")
print(coef_gaussian)

cat("SE for Gaussian copula parameters:\n")
print(se_gaussian)


# ---------------------------
# t copula
# ---------------------------
t_copula <- tCopula(dim = 3, dispstr = "un", df.fixed = FALSE)
fit_t <- fitCopula(t_copula, u, method = "mpl")

# Extract estimated parameters
coef_t <- coef(fit_t)

# Standard errors
se_t <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fit_t)))

bic_gaussian <- get_bic(fit_gaussian, u)
bic_t        <- get_bic(fit_t, u)

cat("BIC for Gaussian Copula:", bic_gaussian, "\n")
cat("BIC for t Copula:", bic_t, "\n")

# Print results
print(fit_t)

cat("Estimated parameters for t copula:\n")
print(coef_t)

cat("SE for t copula parameters:\n")
print(se_t)
```
